svg.text: mini-TD-MPC2: learn a latent model, then plan
TD-MPC2 at its 5M size, learned offline from LIBERO-90 demonstrations.
A world model with no decoder
One step = one action chunk: 5 actions, scaled into [−1, 1].
Unroll 3 chunks, match the real future
Step t weighted by ρᵗ; z′ = E(real next frame); Q_targ: EMA, min of 2.
π only proposes 24 of the plans
The sim runs the chunk's 5 actions, then the robot plans again.
